meta.title: Wiktor Dawid | Full-Stack Web Developer
meta.description: Full-stack web developer — React, Next.js and WordPress. I build fast, responsive websites and online stores: from interface design through backend and database to deployment.

hero.subtitle: Hi, I'm Wiktor — I build websites and online stores.
hero.tagline: I work with React, Next.js and WordPress — from interface design through backend to deployment.

carpentry.title: Stolarstwo Komendera
carpentry.subTitle: Bespoke solid-wood furniture studio website
carpentry.description: A refined showcase site for a local carpenter, designed to present bespoke solid-wood furniture, selected work, the maker's story and a clear path to a custom enquiry.

bailiff.title: Bailiff's Office
bailiff.subTitle: Informational legal platform with an admin panel
bailiff.description: The most advanced site I've built so far. From the design — which had to stay purely informational for legal reasons — to the technical side: a custom API wired to a database, full CRUD operations and Firebase authentication for user credentials.

infotax.title: Biuro Rachunkowe Info-Tax
infotax.subTitle: Accounting firm website built on WordPress
infotax.description: A clean, professional website for an accounting office in Bielsko-Biała. It presents the firm's services, builds trust with prospective clients and makes getting in touch easy. Built on WordPress with Elementor so the client can manage content on their own.

ansbb.title: Virtual Campus — my own frontend
ansbb.subTitle: Personal project: a student portal rewritten from scratch
ansbb.description: My university's portal was awkward enough that I built my own. I hooked into their API and pulled the timetable, grades and messages into a single view — with JWT auth, an SQLite cache and a Hono backend. I host it myself, in a container. Unofficial, built purely for my own use.

patrycja.title: Patrycja Dawid Photography
patrycja.subTitle: Website for an animal photographer
patrycja.description: The first real website I built — for my cousin, who photographs dogs and horses. The whole layout is meant to step back so the photos carry the attention: a custom design built around her logo colours, a gallery split by category, a services section and an availability calendar next to the contact form.

about.heading: About Me
about.firstParagraph: I build websites and web apps commercially — from the front end in React and Next.js, through themes and stores on WordPress and WooCommerce, to APIs, databases and deployment. I work at the Spec od IT agency, where I take client projects from a Figma mockup all the way to production.
about.secondParagraph: I live in Kęty, Małopolska. Outside of work you'll find me at the gym, out for a run, deep in hardware videos, or exploring a new game.
about.thirdParagraph: I also have a wonderful dog, Nero — he never fails to bring a smile to my face.
